name: Gallup Q12 Employee Engagement Survey
description: A 12-item survey measuring employee engagement through needs met at work, from basic needs to growth. Strongly linked to business outcomes including productivity, profitability, and retention.
reputation: Most widely used employee engagement benchmark; 35M+ employees surveyed; global normative database.
notes: Proprietary survey; organizations must license from Gallup; 12 items may miss context.
